language_gaps.text: An anonymous basket can contain multiple lines; one representative line is modeled per invocation
The shopper basket update and anonymous basket deletion are separate commits; the compose treats them atomically

properties.text: without a basket cookie, no basket is merged or deleted
a cookie that is not a GUID does not start a basket transfer
if no anonymous basket exists, the signed-in basket is not created or changed
a successfully transferred line moves from the anonymous basket to the shopper basket
after a successful merge, the anonymous basket is deleted and the shopper basket exists
when the shopper already had the item, their previous unit price prevails
login transfers a basket only when a cookie exists and contains a GUID
login deletes a present cookie unless an empty user name aborts the transfer
basket line quantities are never negative
merging into an existing shopper line adds the anonymous quantity
when a shopper already has an item, their existing unit price takes precedence
an item missing from the shopper basket is copied from the anonymous line
deleting a basket removes the basket and its lines
